ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the scope of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including the Feeding Our Future case and other recent investigations
questions: What is the scope of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How are state officials responding to the issue?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and shed light on a critical issue affecting the state's most vulnerable populations. I recommend starting with a review of recent investigations and arrests, and then following the money to identify patterns and connections.
